messages:
mira: heads up — canary hit a rerank crash after we shipped quant-embed-v2 + the new batching helper into sampleapp. short log:
```
TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for dot: 'bytes' and 'float'
at rerank_service.py:58
```
mira: looks like node sampleapp returned embeddings as base64 bytes (quant pack) while python sampleapp returned floats. rerank tried to dot the two and exploded
theo: wow that's nasty. so two orthogonal parity problems: (1) encoding/format drift (base64-quant vs float32 arrays), (2) batching helper reorder/pad interactions we saw earlier
sdk-ella: which SDK versions?
mira: node-sdk 1.3.0 (auto-quant returns base64 when model.quant=true), python-sdk 0.6.4 (returns float arrays). both called the same model name but different client-side heuristics serialized the embeddings differently
sdk-ella: ah — we added an optimization in node to pack quantized embeddings into base64 bytes by default to save bandwidth. python hasn't shipped that. total oversight on interop
mira: customer had mixed workers (node + python) and a rerank call assembled candidates from both sources. result: mixed representation + dims were fine but types mismatched
ops-max: also noticed auth retry causing duplicate candidates in one batch. one request retried after a 401 and the retried copy used a different encoding (old worker vs new), so the mixed types ended up in the same rerank payload
theo: short-term mitigation: patch sampleapp to normalize embeddings before rerank — if value is base64 decode to float32, else leave as-is. add assert that types are uniform and return clear error 
ci-bot: opened PR sampleapp#900: "normalize embedding encoding before rerank + assert uniform type" — CI queued
sdk-ella: long-term: two things — (A) server should expose response_format in EmbeddingResponse metadata (e.g., "float32", "quant_base64"), (B) SDKs should default to the same serialization for the same model and expose an explicit `format` flag so users choose deterministically
mira: also propose rerank server validates input types and returns structured error {"code":"EMB_FORMAT_MISMATCH","message":"mix of float32 and quant_base64 in candidate_embeddings"} instead of a python TypeError
ops-max: add idempotency token to batch calls to avoid dupes on auth refresh/retry, and include client sdk+version in request metadata (PII-safe) so support can triage quickly
sdk-ella: I'll own the SDK parity task: unify default serialization and add `embedding_format` metadata. will follow up with PRs for node/python and update sampleapp quickstart to print format on create
theo: I'll push the sampleapp hotfix if CI passes. customer reported canary down but they appreciate the rapid response
mira: thanks all — rolled the hotfix to canary and notified customer. follow ups: RED-embed-enc-1 (format metadata), RED-embed-enc-2 (rerank validation & structured errors), RED-embed-enc-3 (batch idempotency). closing loop after canary verification :thumbsup:
